tasks.instruction: Odpowiedz na pytania (1.1.-1.5.) dotyczace wiedzy o krajach anglojezycznych. Odpowiadaj po angielsku. W pytaniach oznaczonych 2 pkt nalezy podac dwie informacje.

items.question: What is the name of the traditional English folk dance performed with sticks, bells and handkerchiefs?
What does the idiom 'to let the cat out of the bag' mean?
Which night do British people celebrate on 5th November? Which man does it commemorate?
What is the name for the variety of English spoken in the East End of London, famous for its rhyming slang?
What is the name of the traditional meal eaten in British homes on a Sunday afternoon?
